sources.title: Republic of Kiribati, Public Holidays Ordinance (Cap. 81) (Section 6, 9), Order (Alteration of days appointed to be public holidays), 18 December 2025 (Office of Te Beretitenti, Gazettes & Instruments: National Public Holiday 2026; scanned, read as images)
sources.said: IN EXERCISE of the powers conferred upon me by section 6 of the Public Holidays Ordinance (Cap. 81), I hereby declare the following days to be public holidays for 2026. Thursday, 1st January New Year’s Day; Friday, 2nd January Kiribati Holiday; Monday, 9th March In honour of International Women’s Day; Friday, 3rd April Good Friday; Monday 6th April Easter Monday; Tuesday, 7th April National Health Day; Friday, 1st May International Labour Day; Monday, 22nd June In honour of National Police Day; Friday, 10th July Gospel Day; Monday 13th July In honour of National Day; Tuesday 14th July Kiribati Culture and Senior Citizens Day; Wednesday, 15th July Kiribati Special Day; Monday, 3rd August National Youth & Children’s Day; Monday, 5th October World Teachers Day; Friday 11th December In honour of Human Rights Day; Friday, 25th December Christmas Day; Monday, 28th December In honour of Boxing Day (Gift Day); Tuesday 29th December Kiribati Holiday; Wednesday 30th December Kiribati Holiday; Thursday 31st December Kiribati Holiday. I further declare that any day appointed to be a public holiday under section 2 of the Ordinance that does not appear in the list above shall be a public holiday in 2026. Dated this 18th day of December, 2025. TANETI MAAMAU, BERETITENTI.
